Name: Abinadab of Kirjath-jearim
Summary: Abinadab of Kirjath-jearim kept the ark of the Lord in his house for twenty years after it was returned from the Philistines, and his son Eleazar was set apart to guard it.
KeyStory: Abinadab's house sheltered the ark through two decades when Israel had no king.
RelatedPeople: Eleazar, Son of Abinadab; Uzzah, Son of Abinadab; Ahio, Son of Abinadab
LifeLesson: Quiet, unseen keeping of holy things matters as much as public ministry.
